spans.s:
ऋत्व n. timely seed;
 the menses.
1 ऋत्वन्त m. the end of a season.
2 ऋत्वन्त a. forming the end of a season (a day).

ऋत्वृइ॑ज् a. sacrificing at the proper seasons;
 m. a priest.

1 ऋत्वि॑य a. orderly, regular, corresponding to or knowing
the sacred rules.

2 ऋ॑त्विय f. आ menstruating;
 n. menstruation.
